tns:patch.author: bmokandu
tns:patch.description: Add TruBudget bulk import user global setting with dropdown of TruBudget-enabled users.

script.lang:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_g_settings_trubudget_enabled_users AS SELECT u.id::text AS id, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(u.first_names, ''), ' ', COALESCE(u.last_name, ''))) || ' (' || u.email || ')' AS value FROM dg_user u WHERE u.trubudget_enabled = TRUE AND u.banned = FALSE AND u.tru_budget_password IS NOT NULL AND u.email IS NOT NULL ORDER BY u.first_names, u.last_name, u.email;
INSERT INTO amp_global_settings (id, settingsname, settingsvalue, possiblevalues, description, section) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM amp_global_settings), 'TruBudget Bulk Import User', (SELECT id FROM v_g_settings_trubudget_enabled_users LIMIT 1), 'v_g_settings_trubudget_enabled_users', 'User account used to authenticate TruBudget bulk project import jobs', 'trubudget' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM amp_global_settings WHERE settingsname = 'TruBudget Bulk Import User' );
